title: The Vibe Companion: Claude Code in your browser
description:
Claude Code is terminal-only, but someone reverse-engineered a hidden SDK URL flag in the binary and built a full web UI. No API key needed, it runs on your existing Claude Code subscription. Now run Claude Code from your browser with multiple sessions, real-time streaming, approve/deny permissions, and nested subagent visualization. Includes live cost tracking, drag-drop images, and dark mode.

https://github.com/The-Vibe-Company/companion
